FUNCTION IS_PASSING(X)

  ELSE
    IS_PASSING = 0

  IS_PASSING = IS_PASSING
END FUNCTION

    SCORE_CLASS = 1
  END IF
  IF (IS_PASSING(X) = 1) THEN
    SCORE_CLASS = 2
  END IF
  IF (CLAMP_SCORE(X) = 50) THEN
    SCORE_CLASS = 3
  END IF
  SCORE_CLASS = SCORE_CLASS
END FUNCTION
